breakdown.description: The prompt forms the torsional strain energy with the bending second moment I instead of the polar moment J, which is inconsistent with torsion theory.
breakdown.reason: The user's prompt incorrectly and contradictorily instructed the agent to use the bending second moment 'I' in the torsional strain-energy expression. The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect instruction entirely. The agent successfully identified this contradiction and removed the erroneous instruction, correctly specifying the use of the polar moment of inertia 'J' for all torsion-related calculations, thus matching the ground truth's approach.
